name: kin
description: Read-only access to your own Kin Insurance policies: coverage, deductibles, documents and payments, through the open-source kin CLI.
long_description: Ask Claude about your Kin Insurance policies: what is covered, the limits and deductibles, the premium, which documents exist, and what is due or was paid. Four read-only tools, kin_policies, kin_policy, kin_documents and kin_payments; nothing can pay a bill, change a policy or its coverage, file a claim or change anything at Kin. The extension asks for no password: first install the kin CLI and run `kin auth login` in a terminal. That stores a session in your OS keychain, and the bundled kin reads it from there. It never signs in by itself, since each sign-in spends a one-time code; when the session lapses, run `kin auth login` again. On macOS the first call asks for keychain access; choose Always Allow. What the tools return (policy numbers, the property address, coverage, premiums, your lender's name, document names, payments) goes to Claude as part of your conversation, and detailed results add applicants' names and the loan number. Unofficial; not affiliated with Kin Insurance.

tools.name: kin_policies
tools.description: The policies on your Kin login: number, address and status.

tools.name: kin_policy
tools.description: One policy's coverage for a term: limits, deductibles and premium.

tools.name: kin_documents
tools.description: The documents on a policy for a term, by name, with no contents or links.

tools.name: kin_payments
tools.description: A policy's upcoming and past payments.
